event.title: Infantino Urges FIFA Members to Support World Cup Sale Plan for Funding
event.canonical_title: Infantino Urges FIFA Members to Support World Cup Sale Plan for Funding
event.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has called on member countries to agree to a proposed sale plan for World Cup rights, warning that failure to do so could result in missing out on $40 million in funding. The plan, which is backed by Jared Kushner, has faced criticism from various quarters, including UEFA. Infantino has set a deadline for FIFA members to respond to the offer.

timeline.title: FIFA President Infantino Announces Deadline for $20M Offers to Member Federations
timeline.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has set a deadline of September 19 for the 211 member federations to accept one-time offers of $20 million. This initiative is part of a plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors.
key_facts: Gianni Infantino is the FIFA President.
September 19 is the deadline for member federations.
$20 million offers are part of a project to sell World Cup stakes.
